label: Auditorium 21, Technical University of Denmark (Lyngby)
note: lecture auditorium with hard wooden chairs and desks; 2 sources x 5 receivers (4.6 to 12.8 m from source 1), measured 15 Feb 2013 with ODEON's 4 s sweep; ISRA 2013 paper; the authors give T30 1.89 s at 1 kHz (ISRA 2013), and RIRDB measures 1.90 s

label: Hagia Sophia, Istanbul
note: Byzantine church, later mosque; ISRA 2013: almost 100 m long, about 54 m high, volume around 200,000 m3 with many coupled volumes, mid-frequency reverberation close to 10 s; measured in the CAHRISMA project (3 sources x 12 receivers; R2-R12 17 to 86 m from source 1 (ISRA 2013); R1, not in the paper, about 5 m: direct sound 13.5 ms into S1R1); the CAHRISMA IRs carry little above about 8 kHz (effective bandwidth 8.2 kHz in the 44.1 kHz files), so values in the 8 kHz octave are not reliable

label: Outdoor corridor with a flutter echo (location not stated)
note: one first-order B-format IR (FuMa W X Y Z) measured with a Zoom H3-VR; the ZIP also holds an ODEON model of the corridor; RIRDB measures rt_mid 1.69 s (EDT 0.27 s), which is the slow decay of the flutter echo between the corridor walls rather than a room reverberation, and the 1.01 s file ends while still decaying, about 62 dB below the peak
